description: Combine shapes as the Pathfinder panel does: unite, minus front, intersect, exclude, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline, minus back, and the Effect > Pathfinder colour operations hard mix, soft mix and trap. The items are grouped and the Pathfinder effect applied; with expand (default) the result becomes plain paths, otherwise it stays a live effect on the group

expand.description: Expand the result to plain paths. Default true

method.description: effect (default) applies the Pathfinder effect; menu runs the Live Pathfinder menu command on the selection instead (not for soft mix or trap, whose commands open a dialog)

mixRate.description: Soft mix: mixing rate in percent. Default 50

removeRedundantPoints.description: Pathfinder Options > Remove Redundant Points. Default false

removeUnpainted.description: Divide and Outline: remove unpainted artwork. Default false

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

trapTintReduction.description: Trap: tint reduction in percent. Default 40

name: pathfinder
title: Pathfinder
